title: [review] project-LICHEN-6mij.2.4: config_put in coap_server.c not refactored to use coap_oscore_authorize_mutating
description: config_put at coap_server.c:196 still uses bare lichen_coap_is_local_admin() without OSCORE support (no coap_oscore_authorize_mutating). All other mutating handlers in coap_dtn.c, coap_keys.c, and msg_inbox_post were refactored, but config_put was missed. Unprotected ops cannot be authorized via OSCORE.
